section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the opening heading and date of the maamar.
section.t: With the help of Heaven.
19 Kislev 5715*

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the levels from Atzmus Ein Sof to the ten Sefiros of Atzilus as enumerated in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar.
section.t: Eliyahu opened and said,
"Master of the worlds, You are One and not in number,
You are the highest above all high,
the hidden above all hidden,
no thought can grasp You at all,
You are He who brought forth ten adornments which we call the ten Sefiros."
And it is explained by my father-in-law, the Rebbe, in his maamar beginning with the word "Zeh"
which he said on 19 Kislev
that all the levels from the Essence of Ein Sof to the ten Sefiros of Atzilus are enumerated here.
"You are One" is the Essence of Ein Sof,
and in Keter it is the innerness of Keter,
Atik.
And regarding this level it says "and not in number,"
that it is not in the number of the matters enumerated afterwards,
for all the matters enumerated afterwards
(including also "the highest above all high")
are incomparable relative to "You are One,"
therefore it is not counted with them,
not in number.
"You are the highest above all high" is the externality of Keter,
Arich.
"The hidden above all hidden" is the Chochmah of Arich.
"No thought can grasp You at all" is the innerness of Chochmah.
"You are He who brought forth ten adornments,"
they are the ten Sefiros of Atzilus.
And it explains,
that the reason that in Atzilus the Sefiros are in number
(ten adornments)
is,
because Atzilus is included in the order of Hishtalshelus
(limitation),
and in Hishtalshelus the concept of number applies.
And from this it is understood,
that the matters enumerated here are divided generally into three categories.
"You are One" which refers
(as above)
to Atik,
is removed and separate from Hishtalshelus,
"You are the highest above all high,"
which is above Hishtalshelus but relates to Hishtalshelus,
"You are He who brought forth ten adornments,"
they are the ten Sefiros of Atzilus,
Hishtalshelus.
And it continues in the maamar,
that through the service of mesirus nefesh they draw down from the level of "You are One" into the ten Sefiros.
And through this the revelation of that which is above nature is drawn into nature.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the levels above the ten Sefiros are above nature, and questions why a revelation above nature is needed within nature.
section.t: B)
Now, from that which it says in the maamar of "Patah Eliyahu" — "You are He who brought forth ten adornments... to conduct the worlds through them,"
that the reason for the emanation of the ten Sefiros of Atzilus is so that through them there will be the conduct of the worlds,
it is understood,
that the levels above the ten Sefiros are above the conduct of the worlds.
Accordingly,
also the revelation of "You are the highest" etc. is above nature.
And in the maamar it says that the drawing down of the revelation that is above nature is through the drawing down from the level of "You are One."
It also needs to be understood,
that since the conduct of the world according to nature is that Ein Sof conducts the world in this manner,
"You are He who brought forth ten adornments... to conduct the worlds through them,"
why is it necessary that within nature there be the drawing down of the revelation that is above nature?
And although that which Ein Sof conducts the worlds through the ten Sefiros is through His enclothing in the vessels of the ten Sefiros
[for the conduct of the worlds is from the light that is enclothed in the worlds,
and in order for the light to be enclothed in the worlds it is through being enclothed
(first)
in the vessels],
nevertheless, even after the light is enclothed in the vessels and in the worlds, it is connected with Ein Sof, Who has no end.
And as explained in the continuation of 5666
that this that in the conduct of nature there is the matter of constancy
(although nature is from the Divine vitality that is enclothed in the creations,
which is limited vitality),
is,
because the source of the vitality that is enclothed in the creations is from the light of the line,
whose source is from Ein Sof before the tzimtzum,
and the perfection of nature is through the revelation of that which is above nature being drawn into it.
